contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANTIV S PF AVG ; R/ VICTORIA DD AVGGQ NN

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, probably of Constantius II (323-361) , Trier mint two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17; cf. RIC volume 8 no. 2183 with TRP mintmark in exergue. Obverse description: Youthful bust rosette diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTIV S PF AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding up wreaths; a heart-shaped leaf with stem below the wreaths. Reverse inscription: VICTORIA DD AVGGQ NN. In exergue: TRS. Diameter: 14.9mm, Weight: 1.57gms, die axis: 6
